data.summary: Beispielfunk Mobile GmbH informs Johanna Beispielacker that the monthly price of her "Beispielfunk Allnet 15" tariff will rise from €14.99 to €16.99 starting 1 January 2027, with all services staying the same.
data.explanation: Your mobile provider is raising the monthly price of your tariff from €14.99 to €16.99 from 1 January 2027 onward; the services included stay unchanged. Because this is a price increase, you have a special right to cancel the contract early, free of charge and without the usual notice period. You can decide whether to accept the new price or cancel instead — the app will show you until when you can use this special cancellation right. If you do nothing, the contract simply continues at the new price.
